name: Retire /awos:roadmap: notice over the local body, delete the template, rewrite a pristine wrapper
description: Graceful shutdown of the roadmap command (decided 2026-09-17). The project's local .awos/commands/roadmap.md becomes a removal notice (created where only the wrapper remains), so calling /awos:roadmap answers that the feature left AWOS instead of running a frozen 1.x copy. The orphaned .awos/templates/roadmap-template.md is deleted — nothing reads it once the command is a notice. A wrapper byte-identical to any shipped 1.x version (if_sha256) is rewritten to a removal wrapper so the palette says the command was removed; a customized wrapper and the user's context/product/roadmap.md are left untouched. The notice below prints once, when this migration applies.

content: `/awos:roadmap` was removed from AWOS. AWOS is not a planning or backlog tool: specs are anchored by an explicit topic now, not by a roadmap item. This notice replaced the project's local copy of the old command so that calling it says so instead of running a frozen 1.x copy.
Tell the user the following, then stop. Do not build, update, or review a roadmap document.
- This command no longer ships with AWOS. To start a feature, run `/awos:spec` and state the topic directly.

- If `context/product/roadmap.md` exists, it is theirs: AWOS no longer creates, updates, or marks it, so keeping it current is their own work now — by hand or with a command of their own. While it exists, the spec command still offers its incomplete items as topic candidates.
- To remove this notice, delete `.claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md` and `.awos/commands/roadmap.md`.
description: Removed from AWOS — explains what replaced the roadmap.

notice: /awos:roadmap left AWOS. Calling it now explains what replaced it; your context/product/roadmap.md is untouched and yours to maintain.
To drop the command entirely, delete .claude/commands/awos/roadmap.md and .awos/commands/roadmap.md.
